{"notes": "Visit 2 (2:30). Status: the dark connected line now runs from the nose around the belly to the far right end, ~(28.3,11), including a hook up there. The pale top line runs from ~(6,9.5) to ~(20.5,7.9) and is still unconnected, with a small gap at the nose. It still needs to cross ~7 units to the right end. Correction to visit 1: the pale line near the nose may be Omar's top line, not Jack's tail. I can't attribute it, so I shouldn't assume Jack misplaced anything.

Hana: Strongest this visit. Her belly is finished and connected, so her earlier statement holds. She spotted unprompted that the top line isn't joined at the nose, said so to everyone, took ownership of the joint, and told Omar to keep going. Clear, proactive communication and good collaboration. Still to check: does the nose patch land, and does she then check the middle?

Sofia: Supportive and delegates clearly. She deferred the nose joint to Hana and said she'll check the middle once Omar gets there. She didn't spot the nose gap herself, and her checking is still late and reactive. Earlier praise looks more accurate now that the belly exists.

Omar: The top line now exists and is progressing, but isn't connected and is the main risk. He acks briefly and keeps working, but didn't flag the nose gap himself. Ask how he's pacing and whether he's worried about reaching the middle.

Jack: Said nothing this visit, so I have no new evidence. The hook at the far end may be his tail, but I can't confirm. Next visit: ask what he's placed and whether it's attached, and whether he needs help.

Next visit: check that the nose joint and middle join happen, and who flags problems unprompted."}
